negative_controls.meaning: A replay-critical view that depends on CURRENT_TIMESTAMP is not a function of durable state alone. Identical database bytes can produce different current-state membership at different wall-clock times.
A raw hash/copy of the main .sqlite file does not identify the complete committed database state while committed frames remain in WAL.

The local binding supports one-connection ATTACH transactions in rollback-journal mode. This is not crash/power-loss replication; official SQLite documentation supplies the cross-file atomicity contract when main is file-backed and mode is not WAL.
The scripting-language binding can disable trusted-schema mode. Product adoption still requires regression testing all persistent views/triggers/functions.
A derived FTS health/rebuild receipt can use SQLite FTS5 integrity-check/rebuild primitives when the target build exposes FTS5. Target build availability remains to be measured.

deltas.law: Every replay-critical semantic query is a pure function of explicit semantic epoch/root plus an explicit validity-time parameter; ambient process wall-clock is not an implicit input.
design: replace replay-critical CURRENT_TIMESTAMP views with parameterized query contracts
carry as_of_valid_time and as_of_semantic_epoch in QueryReceiptV2
for live-now reads resolve now once at the cognition-cycle boundary and persist the chosen value in the query/assembly receipt
replay must reuse the persisted as_of value rather than evaluating a new now
deltas.falsifier: BYTE_STABLE_TIME_SHIFT: identical restored DB bytes + same query receipt must return identical result after real wall-clock advances.

deltas.law: A snapshot identity binds a transactionally consistent logical database image and its recovery context, not just hashes of filenames.
deltas.falsifier: COMMITTED_WAL_ONLY_FRAME: snapshot verifier must reject a main-file-only artifact that omits a committed WAL frame.

deltas.law: Static schema compatibility and dynamic projection freshness are distinct. ClayGraph is usable only through an admitted projection certificate bound to a canonical semantic head.
deltas.truth_rule: The authoritative admission row lives in UnifiedDB. ClayGraph may mirror the receipt id/digest but cannot self-admit.

query_policy.truth_critical: require exact admitted semantic root unless query contract explicitly permits no-Graph fallback
query_policy.exploratory: bounded lag allowed only when lag class/policy is present in the query receipt
query_policy.stale: bypass to canonical state or return explicit degraded/unknown; schedule rebuild

deltas.falsifier: SAME_SCHEMA_DYNAMIC_SKEW: a schema-valid ClayGraph derived from an inadmissible semantic head must not satisfy a truth-critical graph-assisted query.

deltas.law: Record provenance and selection provenance are separately auditable commitments.
deltas.falsifier: AUTHENTIC_RECORDS_UNTRUSTED_SELECTOR: changing only non-admitted graph/index structure must not silently produce an authoritative selection receipt.

deltas.law: state_epochs.root_hash is reproducibly computed from typed canonical state transition commitments, not supplied as opaque text.
deltas.candidate_formula: SHA256(domain='FRANK_SEMANTIC_ROOT_V1' || parent_root || canonical_epoch || tx_receipt_hash || ordered_typed_op_digests || authority_scope_digest || provenance_digest)
requirements: domain separation and canonical byte encoding
ordered operation digests with explicit type identity
same parent + same tx commitments => same root on replay
same parent + any semantic mutation => different root
lineage admission performs compare-and-swap against parent root/epoch
deltas.falsifier: SAME_EPOCH_SIBLING_ROOT: two different typed payloads from one parent must produce distinct roots; a transplanted root must fail replay verification.

deltas.law: Normal cognition opens SQLite with the strongest target-supported non-authoritative-schema posture that preserves Frank's required schema behavior.
initial_candidate: where C binding exists evaluate SQLITE_DBCONFIG_DEFENSIVE
deltas.falsifier: SCHEMA_SIDE_EFFECT_INJECTION: a malicious/rogue persistent schema object must not gain execution authority through application-defined functions or virtual tables.

deltas.law: Every derived retrieval index has a source-root/watermark, health check, rebuild recipe and admission state; successful index lookup never upgrades truth authority.
fts5_profile: external-content integrity-check with rank=1 where applicable
deltas.falsifier: STALE_INDEX_VALID_RECORDS: authentic canonical records retrieved through a stale/corrupted index must not yield an authoritative selection receipt.

SYSTEM_SAFE_DELETE.cross_file_strategy: evaluate bounded ATTACH atomic projection admission
SYSTEM_SAFE_DELETE.expected_tradeoff: stronger two-file commit semantics, more writer/fsync cost

PRIVATE_FIXED_WAL.cross_file_strategy: canonical outbox + StateProjectionCertificate replay; never assume ATTACH set atomicity
PRIVATE_FIXED_WAL.expected_tradeoff: higher read/write concurrency, explicit derived lag/replay

deltas.decision_rule: Keep one semantic/logical contract while selecting physical lowering from measured target evidence.
